Package index

Data retrieval

Functions for retrieving geographic data.

regions()
Get regions
municipalities()
Get municipalities
parishes()
Get parishes
constituencies()
Get constituencies
get_geo()
Get geogrpahies
prefill_cache()
Prefill data retrieval cache

Plotting

Convenient functions for plotting one or more dansih geographic parts. All of these function in the same way and allow you to provide a single name or a vector of names of the areas you would like to plot as well as fill and color options.

plot_denmark()
Plot a map of Denmark with given borders
plot_municipalities()
Plot selected (or all) municipalities
plot_regions()
Plot selected (or all) regions

Integration with other pacakges

Functions to enhance data from other packages

geodk_enrich()
Enrich a dataframe with geographic data
